# QPST

**Author:** QUALCOMM Incorporated<br/>
**Platforms:** BREW

<div className="screenshot">

![QPST: screenshot 1](./qpst/img/qpst.png)

</div>

Qualcomm Product Support Tools is a suite of service utilities for phones based on Qualcomm AMSS with BREW. It includes:

- QPST Configuration for configuring connections;
- Software Download for firmware flashing and backing up NV parameters;
- EFS Explorer for working with the phone file system;
- Service Programming for configuring service parameters;
- RF NV Item Manager for reading and modifying RF NV parameters.
